bio.text: Doug Dubitsky has represented Connecticut's 47th House District since 2015 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
As of October 2019, he lived in North Windham.
He earned a bachelor's degree in theater arts and film from SUNY Purchase and a J.D. from the University of Utah College of Law in 1999, and became a partner at Pullman & Comley in Hartford.
Earlier in his career he worked as a designer and technician on television shows, theater productions and trade shows.
